name: Pull-Up (Bodyweight)
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down.
Pause with your chin above the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A classic bodyweight vertical pull that trains the lats, upper back and biceps.
